title: Skip native opening observation and notices when no native declaration entry applies
outcome: Disabled declarations and declarations containing only built-in commands do not trigger a native source capture or a native-credit refusal notice.
acceptance: Check the declaration's applicability before invoking the owner observation, and leave no native turn notice for a disabled declaration or one containing only recognized built-in commands.
Focused coverage proves zero owner source invocations for those inapplicable cases and preserves the original snapshot and authority checks for an applicable native entry.
